title: Lyrical Wildflower Meadow
description: A patchwork meadow of sage, ochre and rose, with fine flower stems, red poppies and a pale sun.
alt: Hand-painted wildflowers and wandering stems in a sage, ochre and terracotta patchwork meadow beneath a pale sun.

portrait.provenance: Exact approved AI-generated portrait supplied by Ian Rastall; original generator and generation date not supplied.

landscape.provenance: New composition made with built-in image_gen on 2026-10-15, using the approved portrait as its reference. Output is 1672×941, not native 4K. Full prompt retained in docs/generation-prompts.json.

allowUpscale.phone: Required 1080×2340 output exceeds the approved 841×1870 portrait. Lanczos3 enlargement is explicit.
allowUpscale.desktop: Required 3840×2160 output exceeds the generated 1672×941 landscape. Lanczos3 enlargement is explicit; not native 4K.

compositionReview: Reviewed on 2026-10-15: portrait crops retain the sun, distant horizon and layered flower stems. The ultrawide focal point is raised to retain the pale sun; some lowest foreground stems are cropped. Tablet and 16:10 retain a balanced field of flowers.
